import { Controller } from '@nestjs/common';
import { OrderDto, OrderPageDto, OrdersControllerBase } from './index.js';
import type { ListOrdersQuery } from './index.js';

/** Sample service: hand-written code extending the generated abstract controller. */
@Controller()
export class OrdersController extends OrdersControllerBase {
  private readonly orders: OrderDto[] = [];

  listOrders(query: ListOrdersQuery): OrderPageDto {
    const page = new OrderPageDto();
    page.items = this.orders.slice(0, query.limit ?? 20);
    return page;
  }

  createOrder(body: OrderDto): OrderDto {
    this.orders.push(body);
    return body;
  }

  getOrder(id: string): OrderDto {
    const found = this.orders.find((o) => o.id === id);
    if (!found) throw new Error(`order ${id} not found`);
    return found;
  }
}
